entries.title: DFE (FCN Base) - Dewarping Document Image By Displacement Flow Estimation with Fully Convolutional Network (2021)
entries.summary: The paper presents a fully convolutional network that estimates dense displacement flow fields to rectify warped document images, enabling accurate dewarping and improved text recognition.

entries.title: DocTr - Document Image Transformer for Geometric Unwarping and Illumination Correction (2021)
entries.summary: DocTr leverages transformer architectures to simultaneously perform geometric unwarping and illumination correction on document images, improving the accuracy of downstream OCR and analysis tasks by normalizing distorted document layouts.

entries.title: Rectinet - A Gated and Bifurcated Stacked U-Net Module for Document Image Dewarping (2020)
entries.summary: Rectinet introduces a gated, bifurcated stacked U-Net module that restores warped scanned document images, enhancing downstream OCR performance.

entries.title: Multistage Curvilinear Coordinate Transform Based Document Image Dewarping using a Novel Quality Estimator (2020)
entries.summary: The paper presents a multistage curvilinear coordinate transform for dewarping document images, using a novel quality estimator to improve accuracy and support downstream analysis tasks. It introduces a pipeline for image enhancement and distortion removal that serves as a critical component for further processing in document imaging systems.

entries.title: 10. DewarpNet - Single-Image Document Unwarping With Stacked 3D and 2D Regression Networks (2019)
entries.summary: DewarpNet introduces a stacked 3D‑2D regression network that predicts per‑pixel warp maps to unwarp scanned document images, restoring their original geometry for improved text extraction and downstream analysis.

entries.title: Docuwarp (2019)
entries.summary: Docuwarp (2019) introduces a technique for dewarping curved document photographs by applying geometric correction and image warping to restore the original flat layout of text pages, thereby improving the accuracy of document analysis.

entries.title: DocUNet: Document Image Unwarping via a Stacked U-Net (2018)
entries.summary: DocUNet introduces a stacked U-Net architecture that reverses geometric distortions in scanned documents, producing flat, legible images that improve OCR accuracy.

entries.title: Robust Document Image Dewarping Method Using Text-Lines and Line Segments (2017)
entries.summary: The paper introduces a real-world dataset of distorted and dewarped document images paired with corrected versions, specifically designed to support quantitative evaluation of dewarping algorithms in document image processing.

entries.title: Document dewarping via text-line based optimization (2015)
entries.summary: This 2015 paper presents a text‑line based optimization approach that aligns and straightens warped document images, restoring them to a flat, readable layout by correcting geometric distortions.

entries.title: A novel model-based dewarping technique for advanced Digital Library systems (2014)
entries.summary: This paper introduces a novel model-based technique for correcting geometric distortions in book images to enhance digitization within digital library systems, focusing on image dewarping as a preprocessing step for improved document analysis.

entries.title: A Model-based Book Dewarping Method Using Text Line Detection (2007)
entries.summary: This 2007 paper presents a model-based dewarping technique that detects text lines in scanned book images to correct geometric distortions, enabling accurate OCR of skewed pages.

entries.title: Dewarping of document image by global optimization (2005)
entries.summary: The paper presents a global optimization approach to dewarp document images, addressing geometric distortions to improve the accuracy of document image processing.

entries.title: RectiNet-v2 - A stacked network architecture for document image dewarping
entries.summary: RectiNet-v2 presents a stacked network design that restores flat, undistorted document pages from curved or warped inputs, enabling accurate OCR by eliminating geometric distortions before text extraction.

entries.authors: Beiya Dai, Xing li, Qunyi Xie, Yulin Li, Xiameng Qin, Chengquan Zhang, Kun Yao, Junyu Han

entries.authors: Jiaxin Zhang, Canjie Luo, Lianwen Jin, Fengjun Guo, Kai Ding
